A split-panel illustration comparing Jahiliyyah and Islam. Left panel (Jahiliyyah - warm dusty colours): a rugged Arab man casting arrows to gamble, a stone idol in the background, and a wealthy merchant angrily demanding doubled payment from a poor debtor. Right panel (Islam - clean cool colours): men of different races standing shoulder to shoulder in Salah, a merchant fairly weighing grain on a scale, and a father joyfully carrying his young daughter on his shoulders. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
